system.description:
Your convictions are rock-solid and the force of your idealism—and your special training—make you an exceptional individual indeed. You gain the following benefits:

  • Your Strength, Dexterity, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • Your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 points of radiant damage to creatures you can detect with your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.01szspr1nunp0lql]{Divine Sense}.

  • Your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.my42mip0qc35rcp2]{Lay on Hands} pool increases by 5.

  • You learn an additional Sanctified Steel maneuver of a degree you could learn. It does not count against your maneuvers known.

  • Choose a skill you are proficient with from the following list to receive an expertise die: Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, or Religion. Your maximum expertise die size for the chosen skill becomes a d10.

  • You can use Lay on Hands on yourself as a bonus action.

Once you have taken this feat, you can no longer gain levels in non-herald classes.
system.prerequisite: Dedicated  Guardian feat, Warrior of Devotion feat, 12 levels in herald, no levels in non-herald classes at time of feat acquisition
